findings.finding: A WhatsApp campaign has a real lifecycle (created → sent → delivered → replied). campPerfState (campaigns-crm.ts:113) models only test / replied>0 / else, so a campaign that was NEVER sent is labelled «بلا ردود بعد» — 'no replies yet', which asserts it went out. Visible in detail-zero@1440x900.png: the header chip says «بلا ردود بعد» 90px above a hero that says «لا جهات استهداف لهذه الحملة — لم يُرسل شيء.» One screen, two contradictory claims.

grill.evidence: §8 clean and verified, not assumed: the only fetch in the module is POST /admin/campaign/test; check:crm asserts a fetch allow-list of 1, refuses non-literal fetch URLs, and scans for sendBeacon/XHR/WebSocket/EventSource/import(). crmRetargetSel stages a cohort into lastDetailCohort and calls startRetarget() — it halts at the wizard's human gate and sends nothing. No template submission, no deletion, no spend. ADR-0001 honoured better than written: the port is a separate module interpolated at two anchors instead of range-edited into dashboard.ts, and crmBoot() + the layered catch are the runtime assertion the round-20 amendment demanded.

findings.finding: crmDrop (campaigns-crm.ts:748) derives the write from a rendered Arabic label: `want = col === "تجريبية"`. The حالة الأداء board emits a column with that identical label (campPerfState line 114). It is unreachable today only because canDrag gates the attributes — the handler itself has no board guard. This is the project's own recorded defect class (MEMORY.md 'Emitted values must be readable'). Key the drop on CRM_KEYS[0][0] === "class" plus the column's key, never its display string.

Against an ask whose verbatim words are «exact design and UX and functionality», a silently-dropped requirement costs more trust than the missing feature costs function.

Consider promoting the single top move to a one-line strip under the hero, tab for the rest.

grill.evidence: Walked all 9 list states and 5 record states at three viewports. Genuinely strong: the bulk bar is Frappe-grade and reads as Massar's own; empty / one-campaign / 400-campaign / zero-target all render deliberately rather than broken; the cap footer names the number it hides; «—» instead of ٠٪ where the denominator is 0; the sparse-degradation notice when grouping adds nothing. a11y.json 21/21 with its uncovered scope declared.

findings.finding: The تجميع view ships WITHOUT column headers. crmGroupView (line 306) emits the group card, then rows, and never the header row that crmListView emits at line 266. At every viewport the operator sees «٦ ٪٠ ٪٠ ▬ ٪٠» — four unlabelled numeric columns, three of them identical-looking. Confirmed in list-group@1440x900.png and list-group@768x1024.png. In قائمة the same columns are labelled الجمهور / مشاهدة / ردود / التقدّم.

Same-screen contradiction, second instance: on the kanban keyed to التصنيف under the فعلية tab, the board renders «تجريبية ٠» while the pill 200px above reads «تجريبية (١)» (list-kanban@1440x900.png). Both are true under their own scope and that is exactly why it reads as a broken count. When the board key equals the filter dimension, the board should run over «الكل» (or the tab should be suppressed) — a class board inside a class filter is a one-column board by construction.

At 375 the campaigns list is a 940px-min-width table inside a horizontal scroller: the phone shows the campaign name, the date, and a clipped «الخدم…» — no status, no audience, no rates without swiping inside the card (list-default@375x812.png). This is INHERITED (the old vKmon used min-width:900px), so it is not a regression — but this rebuild touched every pixel of that row and was the moment to give the phone a stacked card. He QAs on his phone (R21, R32).

«عرض النص كاملًا» is offered whenever msg.length > 90 (line 401), not when the text actually overflows the 2-line clamp. In detail-targets@1440x900.png the whole message is visible on one line and the link is still offered; clicking it changes nothing. Trigger on scrollHeight > clientHeight.

The row-end reclassify control is a bare «⇥» / «↩» glyph in an otherwise iconographic system; and the group «why» caption («تُحدَّد عند الإطلاق ولا تتغيّر») repeats verbatim on every group card when it belongs once, beside the group selector.

grill.evidence: Right shape and I verified the load-bearing parts at the commit: client state only, no endpoint, no migration; bulk reclassify uses bounded concurrency (4 lanes) with a re-entrancy guard, mutates local state only on a confirmed 2xx, and keeps failed ids selected so «تعذّر ٣ — أعد المحاولة» is an instruction that can be followed. The reviewer's hidden-selection defect was closed at the ACCESSOR (crmSelIds/crmSelPhones intersect with what the current filter matches) rather than by adding clear() calls to four handlers — a structural fix, and the belt-and-braces wrappers were kept. Build + all 13 checks green in a clean worktree at 3273b1e.

decisions_ruled.decision: D1 — Kanban built, keyed on real fields, drag only where a write exists
decisions_ruled.reason: He asked for Frappe's view model; a board is the most legible half of it. Keying it on التصنيف/الخدمة/شهر الإطلاق/حالة الأداء invents no lifecycle, and refusing drag where nothing can be persisted is the honest version. BA was right, discovery was wrong.

decisions_ruled.decision: D2 — right-hand field rail dropped on a field census
decisions_ruled.ruling: UPHELD, and it was the better call
decisions_ruled.reason: Verified the census: the campaign has 6 fields; the header renders name/product/date/class; exactly one substantive field (message) was unrendered. A rail would have been four read-only repeats of the header around one real value — structure without content, which is the slop pattern. The launch strip exposes the one field that mattered and does it better than a rail would.

decisions_ruled.decision: D3 — «مكتملة» retired for تجريبية / فيها ردود / بلا ردود بعد
decisions_ruled.ruling: UPHELD IN PRINCIPLE, INCOMPLETE IN EXECUTION
decisions_ruled.reason: «مكتملة» was a claim nothing on the table could back, and retiring it is right even though it changes a label he has seen. But the replacement vocabulary has no word for «never sent», so it now contradicts the verdict the same commit wrote. See must M1.

change_orders.order: Teach campPerfState the distinction crmVerdict already knows. Add a fourth state for a campaign with no send — targeted===0 OR (sent===0 && delivered===0) — with its own label («لم تُرسل بعد» / «بلا جمهور») and its own chip class. Because BR-2's one-function design already exists, this lands on the row chip, the حالة الأداء board column, the group header and the record header in one edit; verify all four rather than crediting them. (b) In the same edit, make the rates honest for that state: when nothing was sent, نسبة المشاهدة / نسبة الردود / جهات مهتمة لكل ١٠٠ are not ٠٪, they are undefined — return null from crmRate so the hero renders «—» exactly as it does for the zero-target case, and the list row's التقدّم with it. Proof: a capture of the never-sent record where the chip, the hero and the three rates all say the same thing.

Render the column header row inside the تجميع view (or once above the group stack). Today crmGroupView emits rows without the header crmListView emits at line 266, so الجمهور / مشاهدة / ردود / التقدّم are four unlabelled numbers at every viewport. Proof: list-group at 1440 and 768 with every column labelled.

When the board key is التصنيف and the class tab is not «الكل», the board contradicts the pill («تجريبية ٠» beside «تجريبية (١)»). Resolve it deliberately: either run the board over all campaigns regardless of the class tab (with the tab visibly neutralised) or suppress the class board under a class filter. Also decide and state what the operator sees when a drag moves a card out of the active tab — today it silently vanishes.

Close the disclosure gap. Write into .orbit/artifacts/campaigns-crm/requirements.md (or an ADR) an explicit dated decision recording that FR-2's filter condition builder and FR-5's columns picker were NOT built, with the reason and the trigger that would build them (my ruling: columns picker stays out — per-browser chrome with no value at this data size; the filter builder is deferred, not cancelled, and its trigger is the first time the campaign count passes ~30 or he asks to slice by a counter or a date range). Then say it to him in ONE line when this is reported — «فلترة الشروط واختيار الأعمدة مؤجّلان» — rather than letting him find it. Do not build either this round.

Deploy. He cannot see any of this today and AC-13's smoke half is open by construction. Deploy the REVIEWED commit, not the working tree — the engine repo is dirty with the concurrent crm-record session's agent.ts/db.ts/index.ts/tracker.ts changes, which must not ride out under this cycle's name. Then `npm run smoke` 7/7 and GET /health ok:true + outbound.ok:true, recorded.

Give the phone a real row. At 375 the list shows a name, a date and a clipped service word inside a 940px sideways scroller; collapse the row into a stacked card (name + status chip + الجمهور + the two rates) below ~600px. Inherited debt, but this rebuild owned the row and he demos from his phone.

crmDrop must not key its write on a rendered Arabic label — «تجريبية» is also emitted as a حالة الأداء column. Pass the column KEY, and assert the active board is "class" inside the handler, so the guard survives someone later making another board droppable.

Trigger «عرض النص كاملًا» on actual overflow (scrollHeight > clientHeight), not on msg.length > 90 — at 1440 it is currently offered on messages that are already fully visible and does nothing when clicked.

Surface the single top «الخطوة التالية» move as a one-line strip under the verdict hero, keeping the tab for the rest. Action points are what he asked for by name (R41a); a click is a lot of distance for the one thing the screen exists to tell him.

Put a removal trigger on the vKmon/vKmonDetail fallback: delete both once one deploy has smoke 7/7 green on #kmon and #kmon/<id>. Two implementations of one screen with no expiry date is how the dead one silently becomes the wrong one.
Replace the «⇥»/«↩» row-end glyphs with the portal's icon set, and hoist the repeated group «why» caption to sit once beside the group selector.
